rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's fourteen builder trees go (corals, ficus and a canary date palm along the back fences, a queen palm and a coral 3-4 m from the house fronts, others by the seating); four come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the two grills, the arbor and the adirondack chair.

trees.why: the back yard with the kettle grill (1.3 m off) and the potted plants: a jacaranda over the cook
the east back yard with the garden arbor (1.9 m off): a magnolia beside it
the north-west yard with the adirondack chair (1.5 m off): a coral tree to sit under
